issue.title: drop_duplicates(split_out) ValueError
issue.body:
python: 3.7.3
dask: 2.5.2

```python
import dask.dataframe as dd

pdf = pd.DataFrame({'data': [tuple([1, 2]), tuple([2]), tuple([3])]})
ddf = dd.from_pandas(pdf, npartitions=2)
ddf.drop_duplicates().compute()  # no problem
ddf.drop_duplicates(split_every=2).compute()  # no problem
ddf.drop_duplicates(split_out=2).compute()  # ValueError: setting an array element with a sequence
```

Any idea why?

P.S. - I know using tuples inside columns is not ideal, but it fits a particular use case. Still it works well if I don't `split_out`, hence though relevant to report.

body:

On the pandas side of things, we could perhaps avoid the `.astype(str)` call. May do it in a list comprehension instead?
